# Security policy

This repository accepts security fixes only. Every other change waits until
it opens for contributions; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report privately through GitHub's **[Report a
vulnerability](https://github.com/oleg-tkachuk/paladin/security/advisories/new)**
form. Do not open a public issue for anything exploitable.

Include the component and commit, the principal you started as and the
authority you ended with, and the shortest reproduction.

Expect an acknowledgement within 3 working days and an assessment within 10.

Scope, known non-findings and the security model:
[docs/security-model.md](../docs/security-model.md).

## Supported versions

Pre-1.0: only `main`. There are no maintenance branches.
